Iconic High Performance Groundcar. Upgrades: TUp (+1 SP) Armored Chassis (w/ Stalwart Shell), TUp (Reduced visual footprint) Bulletproof Glass [x2], TUp (Reduced visual footprint) Combat Plow, TUp (All radio signals from this vehicle are considered Scrambled) Communications Center, CrystalCoat, TUp (Deals 1d6 additional damage [5d6]) Deployable Spike Strips [x2], TUp (Reduced visual footprint) Heavy Chassis, TUp (Turbocharged) Improved Engine, NOS [x2], TUp (Hardwired Locks) Security Upgrade (Advanced), TUp (Can hide Two-Handed Weapons in its holsters) Smuggling Upgrade. Also: Climate Control, TUp (Improved) Racing Tires. Climate control. Racing tires: +2 to Maneuvers on pavement. Ablation to its SP is 1 less (min 0). +4 to Interrogation or Persuasion with anyone in Night City who knows whose car it is. Owning it gives +2 REP, to a maximum of 8, because you're not Rogue. The radio always starts on whichever station is playing Samurai.
